name: Government of India Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
description: Post-matric financial assistance for eligible SC and Neo-Buddhist students studying in Maharashtra.
department: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department
benefit: Tuition fees, examination fees and maintenance assistance subject to scheme rules.
additional_criteria: Applicant must satisfy the applicable post-matric course conditions.
Detailed course and admission conditions must be checked on the official portal.

name: Post Matric Scholarship to OBC Students
description: Financial assistance for eligible OBC students pursuing approved post-matric education in Maharashtra.
department: VJNT, OBC and SBC Welfare Department
benefit: Maintenance allowance and applicable tuition/examination fee support subject to course and institution rules.
additional_criteria: Applicant must belong to OBC category.
Applicant must pursue an approved post-matric course.
Course, admission and attendance conditions apply.

name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna
description: Financial assistance for eligible economically weaker students admitted to approved professional and technical courses through the applicable admission process.
benefit: Tuition fee and examination fee assistance according to applicable course, institution, income and applicant conditions.
additional_criteria: Applicant must satisfy Maharashtra domicile requirements.
Applicable professional or technical course conditions apply.
CAP/admission and attendance conditions may apply.

name: State Government Open Merit Scholarship
description: Merit-based scholarship for eligible Maharashtra students in specified Arts, Commerce, Science and Law streams.
benefit: Merit scholarship assistance according to the applicable scheme rules.
additional_criteria: Fresh applicants need the required qualifying marks.
Applicable Arts, Commerce, Science or Law stream conditions must be verified.

name: Sub-mission on Farm Mechanization
description: Financial assistance to eligible farmers for procurement of agricultural machinery and implements.
benefit: Financial assistance for eligible farm machinery and implements according to applicable subsidy rules.
verification_status: Verified from official MahaDBT Farmer source
additional_criteria: Only applicable components can be selected according to scheme rules.
Previous benefit history can affect eligibility for the same component.

name: Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana
description: Agricultural support scheme for eligible SC farmers in Maharashtra.
benefit: Agricultural support for eligible SC farmers according to the scheme's applicable components and rules.
verification_status: Verified from official MahaDBT Farmer source
additional_criteria: Applicant must satisfy the scheme's farmer and land-related conditions.
Detailed component-specific conditions must be verified on the official portal.
